verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own docs say it runs dbt transformations through its hosted dbt Core integration, and that transformations can be triggered automatically after connection syncs rather than only on a set schedule. That covers sync-triggered runs on freshly loaded data. The evidence is a single line, though, and does not explain how the trigger works (for example, multi-connection dependencies or behavior on failed syncs). missing for 10: documented details of the sync-triggered execution (waiting on multiple upstream connections, handling of failed or partial syncs, dbt Cloud/Coalesce trigger parity), independent or hands-on confirmation that dbt runs fire after loads complete.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, dbt transformations run against freshly loaded data as part of the pipeline, not on a blind timer

citations.quote: Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
Use the Fivetran-hosted dbt Core integration or our third-party dbt Cloud and Coalesce orchestration to centralize and manage all your transformations.
Orchestrate pre-built and custom data transformations in your destination with Fivetran.
